public_smoke_source:
"""Task-owned exact-file receiving evidence for Ackredit 0.12.1."""

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata as metadata
import importlib.util
import json
import platform
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

import ackredit

artifact, source, output, route = map(str, sys.argv[1:5])
artifact, source, output = Path(artifact), Path(source), Path(output)
prefix = Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
digest = hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert digest == "46d505016f6d05d7000adfaedde5f1ce596e32eb70d5302fc7f112c1042a73cb"
assert metadata.version("ackredit") == ackredit.__version__ == "0.12.1"
assert Path(ackredit.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(prefix)
assert not Path(ackredit.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(source)
smoke = runpy.run_path(str(source / "devtools/installed_smoke.py"))
standard = smoke["verify"](expected_python="3.14", expected_version="0.12.1")
distribution = metadata.distribution("ackredit")
package_files = {}
with tarfile.open(artifact, "r:bz2") as archive:
    for member in archive.getmembers():
        if not member.isfile() or not member.name.startswith("site-packages/ackredit/"):
            continue
        relative = PurePosixPath(member.name.removeprefix("site-packages/"))
        assert not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts
        original = hashlib.sha256(archive.extractfile(member).read()).hexdigest()
        installed = Path(distribution.locate_file(str(relative))).resolve()
        assert installed.is_relative_to(prefix) and not installed.is_relative_to(source)
        assert hashlib.sha256(installed.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == original
        package_files[member.name] = original
assert len(package_files) == 70
record = json.loads(next((prefix / "conda-meta").glob("ackredit-0.12.1-*.json")).read_text())
assert record["version"] == "0.12.1" and record["build"] == "py_0"
assert record["sha256"] == digest
expected_url = "https://conda.anaconda.org/uibcdf/" + (
    "label/staging/" if route == "staging" else ""
) + "noarch/ackredit-0.12.1-py_0.tar.bz2"
assert record["url"] == expected_url

example_directory = output.parent / (route + "-example")
example_directory.mkdir()
original_example = source / "examples/citation_provider/citation_provider.py"
copied_example = example_directory / "citation_provider.py"
shutil.copyfile(original_example, copied_example)
sys.path.insert(0, str(example_directory))
import citation_provider

with ackredit.session("installed-receiving"):
    before = ackredit.get_used_items()
    ackredit.validate_provider(citation_provider)
    assert ackredit.get_used_items() == before
    with ackredit.observe_calls(citation_provider):
        with ackredit.capture("first", record_evidence=True) as first:
            assert citation_provider.normalize([1, 3]) == [0.25, 0.75]
        with ackredit.capture("second") as second:
            assert citation_provider.normalize([2, 6]) == [0.25, 0.75]
    for captured in (first, second):
        saved = captured.attribution
        payload = saved.to_dict()
        assert {item["id"] for item in payload["items"]} == {
            "example:software:2.4.0", "example:article"
        }
        assert len(payload["uses"]) == 2
        assert ackredit.Attribution.from_json(saved.to_json()).to_dict() == payload
    enclosing = ackredit.get_attribution()
    assert len(enclosing.to_dict()["items"]) == 2
    assert "example:unused" not in enclosing.to_json()
    evidence = first.evidence
    assert ackredit.AttributionEvidence.from_json(evidence.to_json()).to_dict() == evidence.to_dict()
    saved_path = output.parent / (route + "-attribution.json")
    saved_path.write_text(first.attribution.to_json())
    expected_workflow = first.attribution.report("workflow")

reader = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "-I", "-c", "import pathlib,sys,ackredit; a=ackredit.Attribution.from_json(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()); assert ackredit.get_used_items()=={}; print(a.report('workflow'),end='')", str(saved_path)],
    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
)
assert reader.stdout == expected_workflow
cli = subprocess.run(
    [str(prefix / "bin/ackredit"), "report", str(saved_path), "--input-format", "attribution", "--format", "workflow"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
)
assert cli.stdout.rstrip("\n") == expected_workflow.rstrip("\n")
absent = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "-I", "-S", "-c", "import importlib.util,sys; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]); assert importlib.util.find_spec('ackredit') is None; import citation_provider; assert citation_provider.normalize([1,3])==[.25,.75]; assert 'ackredit' not in sys.modules; print('actual absence passed')", str(example_directory)],
    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
)
pip = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "check"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
receipt = {
    "schema": "ackredit.installed-maintenance-smoke@1",
    "checked_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "version": ackredit.__version__, "python": platform.python_version(),
    "platform": sys.platform, "architecture": platform.machine(),
    "prefix": str(prefix), "origin": ackredit.__file__, "route": route,
    "filename": artifact.name, "sha256": digest, "url": record["url"],
    "conda_record": {key: record[key] for key in ("name", "version", "build", "subdir", "url", "sha256", "depends")},
    "all_original_package_files": package_files,
    "installed_smoke": standard, "pip_check": pip.stdout.strip(),
    "provider_validation_inert": True, "independent_captures": 2,
    "enclosing_workflow": True, "unexecuted_branch_excluded": True,
    "evidence_round_trip": True, "fresh_reader_adds_no_credit": True,
    "cli_matches_saved_report": True, "actual_absence": absent.stdout.strip(),
    "example_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(original_example.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "smoke_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "limits": ["Fictional dependency-free example is not real scientific client qualification; PyUnitWizard's hosted matrix is separate.", "No new publication manager/style or general 1.x claim."]
}
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"version": receipt["version"], "python": receipt["python"], "route": route, "package_files": len(package_files), "pip_check": receipt["pip_check"], "contracts": "passed"}))

limits: Paired performance figures are bounded editable-source snapshots on Linux/Python 3.14.7, not whole scientific-pipeline/RSS/universal installed speed claims.
Installed candidate verifies scaling/fidelity and three 5000-use payloads; it is not a paired installed timing study.
Eight real publication-tool cases were not executed locally for missing external tools; original 0.12.0 manager/style qualifications retain their separate scope.
The exact-file real receiving matrix qualifies its pinned PyUnitWizard producer and released fallback, not every current client release.
Shared editable development environment retains seven unrelated dependency conflicts owned by MolSysSuite #82; clean release prefixes pass pip check.
Existing Setuptools license-table warning is tracked separately in Ackredit #135; no current build failure is asserted.
GitHub Release/tag/public Conda delivery do not establish a Zenodo archive or DOI.
